text: Perdón for writing so late, I know you must be busy. My son is 19 months and his temp is 39.8, I checked it again and it's the same. His eye is pink and sticky, I think it's crusting, and he has the runny nose and sneezing all day, mocos everywhere pobrecito. Also please don't worry about his mouth if I send a photo, it looks purple around the lips but it's blackcurrant juice, it comes off with a wipe, I tried. I think it's probably just a cold but I'm not sure with the fever so high, lo siento for bothering you
